titleEn: Move/migrate to a different number or from another provider

en: How do I change my number or migrate from another provider?

steps: No wizard: turn off two-step verification (the PIN) at the old provider, then connect the number in Numbers the normal way
Templates do not move with the number: install the starter templates and re-submit
Chats and campaigns stay in the workspace; to change number, disconnect the old and connect the new
edgeCases: Number conflict if it is still attached to another account or workspace: remove it there first
Meta decides the quality rating and limit after a move
gaps: Meta does the move; Ebda Chat has no migration screen (a guide only)
